name: PatinaTorrent state icons
notes: Original vector assets; no application integration or copied upstream artwork.
Status precedence: error, moving, checking or queued checking, paused/queued/stopped, active metadata, active seeding/downloading.
CheckingResumeData and CheckingFiles share frontend text but have separate assets. Their queued variants also stay distinct.
Paused is split by is_finished. Stopped complete is the current Finished text; core TorrentState::Finished is a different concept (wanted pieces done with skipped files).
Optional icons are design assets only: no current stalled, no-peers, idle-seed, or allocating status is inferred by existing frontend code.
No incoming connections only means no successful incoming connection has been observed; it does not prove the port is blocked.
Render at 16 px or integer multiples where possible. Outline icons use 1.5 px strokes; filled arrows and pause/stop shapes have integral boundaries.

icons.label: Wanted files complete
icons.source: TorrentState::Finished: all wanted pieces complete, some files skipped
icons.meaning: Open completion ring, check, and small skipped-file tile. Supplemental core detail; current status text calls an active finished torrent Seeding.

icons.label: Moving
icons.meaning: Folder with a rightward move arrow.

icons.label: Error
icons.meaning: Red octagon and exclamation mark.

icons.label: Stalled download
icons.source: No current frontend label; future policy must use a sustained interval, active and incomplete with no payload transfer
icons.meaning: Interrupted down arrow above a blocking bar.

icons.label: Idle seed
icons.source: No current frontend label; active finished torrent with no upload, if product chooses to distinguish it
icons.meaning: Interrupted up arrow and a neutral baseline. Idle seeding is not an error.

icons.label: No peers
icons.source: No current frontend label; candidate condition num_peers == 0, only after an appropriate discovery interval
icons.meaning: Disconnected network nodes with an amber slash.

icons.label: Allocating space
icons.source: Not present in current TorrentState or frontend status text; reserved for a future disk allocation task
icons.meaning: Storage outline with a plus for reserving disk space.

icons.label: Tracker: not contacted
icons.meaning: Gray tracker globe with a hollow waiting indicator.

icons.label: Tracker: working
icons.meaning: Tracker globe and success check.

icons.label: Tracker: updating
icons.meaning: Tracker globe and a refresh arrow.

icons.label: Tracker: error
icons.meaning: Tracker globe with a red exclamation mark.

icons.label: Network OK
icons.meaning: Connected network nodes and a success check.

icons.label: No incoming connections
icons.meaning: Network nodes and a blocked incoming arrow. Amber denotes unconfirmed reachability, not a fatal error.

icons.label: Force-start overlay
icons.source: Optional badge for a custom status combination without AUTO_MANAGED
icons.meaning: Amber lightning badge at upper right. Already included in the three force-start SVGs.
